question: does an MLP BC complete the three DP3 training conditions under DP3's observations, action, budget and stop rule?
scope: execution comparison on a small set; not unseen-object generalisation
observation: Codex Archive.observation(): point_cloud 640x3 + agent_pos 125, history 2 (DP3 sequence_indices padding)
action: 27 final actuator commands; clip to ctrlrange only; nothing added

model.normalisation: limits to [-1, 1] from training data only (point cloud per xyz, state and action per dim, range floor 0.0001)

training.loss: MSE on normalised action at the current tick

evaluation.first_deviation: |q - teacher right_state| > 0.05 rad on an arm joint or 0.1 rad on a finger
evaluation.note: the MLP is deterministic; seeds set as in DP3 for equal budget

differences_from_dp3: one action per tick instead of 8 of a 16-step chunk
